Greetings, Agents! 
 
This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.
​

She-Hulk, the attorney who defends Super Humans, 
and Black Widow, the master spy, will show new abilities!
 
She-Hulk has gained a new Uniform and advanced to Tier-3,
while Black Widow has advanced to Tier-4.
 
Check out their new skills and powers by downloading the 9/6 patch


■ 9/6 Patch Details
​

Patch Schedule: 9/7 (Wed) 3:00 (UTC+0), 9/6 (Tue) 20:00 (PDT)

 

[9/7 (Wed) 2:50 (UTC+0), 9/6 (Tue) 19:50 (PDT) added]

The patch has been completed as of 9/7 (Wed) 2:46 (UTC+0), 9/6 (Tue) 19:46 (PDT). 

Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.

 

* The patch completion time may be changed depending on circumstances 
and the completion time will be provided once the patch has been finished.
* The patch will be applied in waves, so the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch.
* When the patch is done, please restart and apply the patch for better service.

 

▣ One New Uniform

 

This Super Hero has become Hulk after an unexpected accident!
Check out the abilities of the new She-Hulk <Marvel Studios’ She-Hulk: Attorney at Law> Uniform!

 

* The new Uniform can be purchased after the 9/6 Patch data is applied 
and a 40% discount event will be applied to all Uniforms.
* The new Uniform can be found and purchased in the Marvel Universe and the Uniform Room.
* New Uniform Skills are based on the following skill Level stats.
(Tier-4 heroes: Lv. 10, Others: Lv. 6)    

 

* [9/6 (Tue) 7:30 (UTC+0), 9/6 (Tue) 00:30 (PDT) added] 

The leader skill stats of She-Hulk <Marvel Studios' She-Hulk: Attorney at Law>

being wrongly displayed as 20% within the notice has been fixed to 65%.

 

 

 

▣ She-Hulk Tier-3

 

She-Hulk is now available for Tier-3 Advancement.
Check out the powerful abilities of this hearty Super Hero!
 


▣ Black Widow Tier-4
 
Black Widow has trained to gain new skills
to complete her missions without failure. 
*The effects are based on Skill Level 6 stats.

 

 
▣ New Artifacts
 
A new Artifact has been added for She-Hulk.
* The effects are based on the 6★ Artifact passive skill Level 4 stats.

 

 
▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. Book of the Vishanti: Speed has been added to the Giant Boss Raid: Dormammu rewards
 
2. The [Time-Shift Bomb] collection for the Doom's Reign theme 
at the S.H.I.E.L.D. Archive has been added to World Boss Legend: Gorr.
 
We look forward to your active participation in the events that will be held
to support the growth of the updated Super Heroes.
​
Thank you.
